item.title: Mavericks awaiting update on star Cooper Flagg (shoulder)
item.description: The prognosis for Dallas forward Cooper Flagg, who exited the Mavericks' Friday game against the Indiana Pacers in Indianapolis due to left shoulder soreness, was unclear following the contest.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The prognosis for Dallas forward Cooper Flagg, who exited the Mavericks' Friday game against the Indiana Pacers in Indianapolis due to left shoulder soreness, was unclear following the contest. "He'll be evaluated in the next couple of days," Mavericks coach Dusty May said. As for whether Flagg would require an MRI, May added, "I really don't know. I saw him in the locker room, he's in good spirits. We'll know in the next couple days what's next." Flagg, the reigning NBA Rookie of the Year, took a hard foul late in the second quarter and did not return to action. With 59.7 seconds left in the first half, Indiana's Aaron Nesmith challenged Flagg's dunk attempt from behind, sending Flagg sprawling to the floor. After a review, Nesmith was assessed a flagrant-1 foul. Naji Marshall rushed in and shoved Nesmith, resulting in technical fouls for both players. Dallas carried a 77-43 lead into the locker room. "Nesmith's a great guy," May said following the Mavericks' 121-105 win. "Heck of a player. I've known him since he was in high school. An unfortunate play. Hopefully Coop's fine, but obviously it's something we wish wouldn't have happened." Flagg notched 14 points, six assists and five rebounds in 17 minutes of first-half play before being ruled out. The 19-year-old registered 32 points and five rebounds in the Mavericks' season-opening loss to the Houston Rockets. He averaged 21.0 points, 6.7 rebounds and 4.5 assists in 70 games last season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Fire devastates former Nazi guest house 'Eagle's Nest'
item.description: Firefighters battled for hours to contain a blaze that engulfed the former Nazi guest house known as "The Eagle's Nest" in southern Germany, while police investigated the cause after detaining a man near the scene, authorities said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Firefighters battled for hours to contain a blaze that engulfed the former Nazi guest house known as "The Eagle's Nest" in southern Germany, while police investigated the cause after detaining a man near the scene, authorities said on Saturday. Around 200 firefighters and emergency workers near Berchtesgaden in Bavaria were battling the flames after the building, known as the Kehlsteinhaus, caught fire on Friday, police said. Built in 1938 as a guest house for Nazi officials and their guests, the building sits in a spectacular Alpine setting above Berchtesgaden. Adolf Hitler used it occasionally, earning it the nickname "Hitler's Tea House". It is separate from his nearby summer residence, the Berghof. Bild newspaper quoted a police spokesperson as saying the building, preserved after World War Two as a historical monument linked to the Nazi era, had been so badly damaged that it "could probably not be saved". Police said earlier they had detained a man near the site but had not yet established the cause of the fire. "Whether the person is linked to the fire is currently the subject of a criminal investigation," Bavarian police said in a statement.

item.title: Jake Evans tallies twice, adds assist as Canadiens topple Blackhawks
item.description: Jake Evans produced two goals and an assist and Jacob Fowler stopped 20 shots, lifting the visiting Montreal Canadiens to a 4-1 victory against the Chicago Blackhawks on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jake Evans produced two goals and an assist and Jacob Fowler stopped 20 shots, lifting the visiting Montreal Canadiens to a 4-1 victory against the Chicago Blackhawks on Friday. Kaiden Guhle added a goal and assist to help Montreal earn its first road victory since opening night. Mike Matheson also scored as the Canadiens improved to 4-1-1 in their past six games. Connor Bedard scored and Spencer Knight made 24 saves as the Blackhawks fell to 2-3-0 on a seven-game homestand. Chicago started strong, as Bedard opened the scoring at 4:23 of the first period on a snap shot from just outside the left circle. After a Montreal dump-in glanced off a linesman, Patrick Kane collected the puck and slid it to a streaking Bedard in the neutral zone for his second goal this season. Montreal, playing without captain and top center Nick Suzuki (upper body), struggled to find offensive footing in the early going. The Canadiens needed 3:31 to record their first shot on goal and didn't register another for another 2 1/2 minutes. Evans tallied the equalizer at 17:29 of the first period with his first goal of the season, beating Knight with a wrist shot from in front of the net off a feed from Kirby Dach. Montreal took the lead on Evans' short-handed goal at 7:45 of the second period. With the Canadiens pressuring the Blackhawks' five-forward power play, a Kane shot attempt redirected off Tyler Bertuzzi's skate and created an odd-man rush for Montreal. Evans carried the puck down the left side and scored from the circle. Fowler turned aside Roman Kantserov and Kane on a Chicago rush moments later to preserve a one-goal advantage. The Canadiens made it 3-1 at 18:26 of the second. Guhle netted his first goal of the season on a wrist shot from the point. Chicago finished 0-for-5 on the power play compared to 0-for-3 for Montreal. The Blackhawks' final man advantage of the game lasted just 22 seconds in the third period, as Teuvo Teravainen was whistled for interference moments after Montreal's Juraj Slafkovsky was penalized for hooking. Matheson's empty-net goal, his first tally of the season, at 17:22 accounted for the final margin. --Field Level Media

item.title: Pistons jump out to big lead, hand Heat second straight loss
item.description: John Collins scored 23 points and grabbed seven rebounds, and Paul Reed finished with 19 points and 11 rebounds to lead the Detroit Pistons to a 128-111 victory over the host Miami Heat on Friday night.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: John Collins scored 23 points and grabbed seven rebounds, and Paul Reed finished with 19 points and 11 rebounds to lead the Detroit Pistons to a 128-111 victory over the host Miami Heat on Friday night. The Pistons (2-0) led wire to wire after scoring the game's first 11 points and built a lead of as many as 23 in the third quarter. The Heat (0-2) never got closer than eight points after Detroit's early surge despite another strong outing from Giannis Antetokounmpo. Antetokounmpo scored a game-high 36 points, grabbed 12 rebounds and dished out five assists for his first double-double in a Miami uniform. Collins, who shot 5-of-6 from 3-point range, helped Detroit build a 22-5 lead and spearheaded a 47.4% effort from beyond the arc (18-of-38). The Pistons shot 52.8% from the field (47-of-89), with former Heat guard Duncan Robinson making five of 10 3-point attempts and finishing with 17 points. It was another subpar defensive effort for Miami, which allowed 21 3-pointers and 131 points in its season-opening loss to Minnesota on Wednesday. The Heat were hampered in the first half when Bam Adebayo picked up three fouls in the first quarter and sat with 1:13 remaining. Adebayo did not return until the start of the second half. He finished with just four points, six rebounds, three assists and two steals before fouling out. Detroit's Cade Cunningham committed seven turnovers but finished with 16 points and eight assists. Daniss Jenkins scored 15 points, while Isaiah Joe chipped in 12. Miami made 15 3-pointers but shot just 29.4% from long range on 51 attempts. Davion Mitchell totaled 18 points and five rebounds, while Bobby Portis Jr. had 11 points and eight rebounds. The Heat shot just 38.2% from the field. Pistons center Jalen Duren left with 6:45 remaining in the second quarter due to a right thigh injury and did not return. He finished with four points and six rebounds in 10 minutes. --Field Level Media

item.title: US accuses government contractor of leaking classified info to girlfriend's Substack
item.description: The US Justice Department accused a government contractor on Friday of leaking national defense information to his girlfriend, the publisher of a Substack newsletter.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Trotta
item.content:encoded: The US Justice Department accused a government contractor on Friday of leaking national defense information to his girlfriend, the publisher of a Substack newsletter. The FBI arrested Ian Brinksman, 42, on Friday following a search of his Washington home, a Justice Department statement said. Prosecutors charged him with unlawfully transmitting national defense information. A federal public defender representing Brinksman declined to comment. “As alleged, Brinksman reached far outside his own duties to obtain some of our Nation’s most closely held secrets and handed them to a romantic partner he knew intended to publish them,” John Eisenberg, assistant attorney general for national security, said in the statement. “That is not carelessness. It is a betrayal of his oath and the American people who entrusted him to fulfill his duties honorably,” Eisenberg said. Brinksman held a top secret security clearance while working as an employee of a US government agency and later as a developer for systems integration for a private contractor working for the same agency, prosecutors said. According to the sworn affidavit of an FBI agent investigating the case, Brinksman repeatedly accessed classified intelligence reports and then communicated with the journalist. The affidavit also cites phone records, database access logs, badge-swipe records, emails and other evidence. The affidavit only identifies the journalist as "Individual 1," but it cites excerpts from articles she published. "A fundraising article reportedly published by Individual 1 in September 2026 stated 'over the past year [Individual 1 has] published reporting based on classified [relevant U.S. government agency] assessments that I believe the public deserves to know about,'" the affidavit reads. That quote appears in a September 28 piece published on the Capital & Empire online newsletter authored by Aída Chávez. "Over the past year, I’ve published reporting based on classified CIA assessments that I believe the public deserves to know about," wrote Chávez, whose profile on the site notes that she worked for The Nation and other outlets before she launched the newsletter. Chávez did not immediately respond to an email message seeking comment. Investigators allege that on at least five occasions in 2026, Individual 1 published Substack articles containing information that mirrored the classified reports, some at the top secret level. On some of those dates, Chávez published articles that cite classified reports, some of them attributed to the CIA. According to a LinkedIn profile bearing Brinksman's name, he worked for Deloitte as a manager and as a senior strategy security consultant after having worked as a US State Department foreign service officer at dates corresponding to those outlined in the Justice Department statement. Deloitte did not immediately respond to requests for comment. The State Department said it needed more time to respond before commenting.

item.title: SpaceX afronta dificultades en las negociaciones por su deuda de US$40.000 millones para IA
item.description: La volatilidad en los mercados de crédito ha complicado las negociaciones sobre el precio de la operación, diseñada para financiar la compra de chips de Nvidia sin registrar la deuda en los libros con ...
item.dc:creator: Carmen Arroyo, Laura Benitez
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los esfuerzos de SpaceX ( SPCX ) por ultimar una estructura de deuda fuera de balance por valor de US$40.000 millones destinada a la expansión de su división de inteligencia artificial se han visto afectados por las recientes turbulencias del mercado, que han elevado los costes de financiación en todo el sector y han complicado las negociaciones sobre los precios. La operación que se está debatiendo está diseñada para financiar la compra de chips de Nvidia Corp. ( NVDA ) a través de una entidad con fines específicos, lo que mantendrá los pasivos fuera de los libros contables de SpaceX y salvaguardará sus calificaciones de grado de inversión, según fuentes familiarizadas con el asunto. Los banqueros, liderados por Goldman Sachs Group Inc. ( GS ), están debatiendo la estructura con inversores encabezados por Apollo Global Management Inc. ( APO ), y está previsto que Atlas SP —respaldada por Apollo— se encargue de gestionar la entidad, según indicaron dichas fuentes, que solicitaron mantener el anonimato al tratar información privada. Pacific Investment Management Co. también está valorando la posibilidad de invertir, según las mismas fuentes. Ver más: SpaceX negocia acceso a 80.000 estaciones base en EE.UU. para su nueva red móvil Aunque las negociaciones sobre el precio siguen en curso, encontrar niveles en los que ambas partes puedan ponerse de acuerdo se ha complicado debido a la inquietud que se ha extendido por los mercados de crédito en los últimos días, según indicaron las fuentes. Los inversores en deuda están cada vez más preocupados por la enorme carga de deuda que se está acumulando para financiar inversiones en IA, lo que está provocando una ola de ventas de acciones del sector de la IA, ampliando los diferenciales de los bonos corporativos y haciendo que los indicadores de riesgo crediticio se disparen. Las negociaciones de las últimas semanas habían situado una parte subordinada de la deuda en un rango de rendimiento en torno al 8%, aunque la reciente volatilidad ha obligado a los inversores a volver a empezar desde cero, según indicaron dichas fuentes. Los representantes de SpaceX y Atlas no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios, mientras que los de Goldman, Apollo y Pimco se negaron a hacer declaraciones. Ver más: Fusión de Tesla y SpaceX podría aumentar la fortuna de Elon Musk en US$110.000 millones Con la estructura más reciente, SpaceX podría evitar que se repita el intento de financiación del año pasado por parte de xAI, la startup de IA de Elon Musk. En esa operación, una entidad buscó obtener hasta US$20.000 millones en deuda fuera de balance mediante un acuerdo de venta con arrendamiento posterior (sale-leaseback) con Valor Equity Partners, un aliado de larga data de Musk. Sin embargo, SpaceX tuvo que contabilizar finalmente unos US$13.000 millones de esa deuda como propia después de que los auditores la declararan un “acuerdo de venta con arrendamiento posterior fallido”, según el informe de resultados de SpaceX publicado esta semana. En el marco de la operación propuesta, los banqueros que asesoran a SpaceX están buscando la estructura de una entidad con fines específicos (SPV), dado que la deuda de la empresa se encuentra a solo unos pocos niveles de calificación por debajo de la categoría de “basura” y sus bonos actuales cotizan a niveles de grado especulativo. Goldman también podría asumir parte de la deuda, según estas fuentes. Se espera que el paquete de deuda se emita en tres tramos de los denominados bonos 144a, una estructura de colocación privada que se ha vuelto habitual en la captación de fondos para unidades de procesamiento general, o chips. Ver más: Acción de SpaceX se dispara en bolsa: la IA supera a Starlink y Wall Street cree que puede subir 50% Un tramo subordinado oscilará entre US$25.000 y US$30.000 millones, y los otros dos tramos serán de US$10.000 millones y hasta US$5.000 millones, según indicaron las fuentes. Las conversaciones iniciales habían situado la deuda en diferenciales que oscilaban entre 230 puntos básicos por encima de los índices de referencia para algunos de los préstamos y más de 300 puntos básicos, según indicaron. Esta última operación se produce tras unos sólidos resultados del tercer trimestre, en el que la unidad de IA de SpaceX obtuvo ganancias por primera vez. La empresa está impulsando cada vez más sus ingresos mediante la venta de potencia de cálculo de sus centros de datos de Memphis a laboratorios de IA externos y a hiperescaladores. El aumento de la elevada carga de deuda de SpaceX podría ejercer presión sobre sus calificaciones crediticias, justo cuando se intensifican las necesidades de capital para centros de datos y chips. Durante la conferencia sobre resultados de SpaceX celebrada el martes, el director financiero, Bret Johnsen, indicó que la captación de deuda continuará, citando conversaciones con varias fuentes de capital de deuda disponibles. Ver más: Fusión de Tesla y SpaceX: 5 preguntas para entender el gigante de US$3,6 billones que estudia Elon Musk “Estamos plenamente convencidos de que podremos llevar esto a cabo de forma muy mesurada y seguir manteniendo nuestra calificación de grado de inversión (IG) a lo largo del proceso”, afirmó. Para Apollo, esta operación se suma a una serie de importantes financiaciones en el ámbito de la inteligencia artificial. Se espera que la estructura adopte un enfoque similar al de una operación de gran envergadura que Apollo lideró a principios de este año y que permitió a Anthropic PBC adquirir chips de Broadcom Inc. ( AVGO ). En aquella operación, la gestora de activos utilizó su unidad Atlas para recaudar capital y mantener la deuda fuera del balance de Broadcom, sin dejar de contar con una garantía de esta empresa de primer orden. Apollo afirmó que se trataba de su operación más compleja hasta la fecha. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Typhoon Champi sweeps past Taiwan, leaving 1 dead, 500 injured
item.description: Typhoon Champi swept past Taiwan on Saturday, killing 1 person and injuring more than 500, downing trees and severing power, as it continued to weaken and head north towards the Chinese coast though it was not expected to make landfall there.
item.dc:creator: Yimou Lee, Angie Teo, Ann Wang
item.content:encoded: Typhoon Champi swept past Taiwan on Saturday, killing 1 person and injuring more than 500, downing trees and severing power, as it continued to weaken and head north towards the Chinese coast though it was not expected to make landfall there. At one point a super typhoon and one of the strongest storms in the Pacific this year, Champi is weakening though still packing gusts of around 126 kph (78 mph) near its centre, according to Taiwan's Central Weather Administration. The storm was about 170 km (106 miles) northeast of Taiwan, having glanced off the island's northeastern coast in Yilan County early on Saturday, the CWA said. The centre of the storm turned south around midnight, hugging the Yilan coastline before making a rare loop offshore and moving away northward. Wind gusts touched 227 kph (141 mph) in some coastal areas, knocking down power lines and sending roof tiles flying. 'MOST TERRIFYING AROUND MIDNIGHT' "It was most terrifying around midnight," said a retired teacher surnamed Lin as he inspected downed banana trees in his garden in Yilan. "It was a sleepless night. I haven't seen anything like this in many years." The storm's forecast track shows it turning north, tracking up the Chinese coast and eventually moving into southern Japan. Taiwan's fire department said the death toll remained at 1, a man swept away by waves from the island of Liuqiu, with 527 injuries during the heavy wind and torrential rain. Taipower said more than 288,000 homes had lost electricity, though most had been reconnected. The transport ministry said 259 flights were cancelled, an improvement from Friday, when the number was almost 1,000. In the capital Taipei, there were downed trees and on-off squally rain showers. Taipei resident Thomas Wang, 70, said the storm felt like something out of the horror film "Poltergeist". "It was quite scary," he said, out running morning errands. Governments in a swathe of northern and central Taiwan, including Taipei, declared a second day of office and school closures on Saturday. Although more common in summer, typhoons can strike in autumn too. China's emergency management ministry sent a team to the eastern province of Zhejiang as Champi approached, warning of strong winds and heavy rain through Sunday. It said it had readied 400 rescue workers and 600 pieces of equipment, while more than 41,000 firefighters were on emergency duty. In Taizhou, a city on Zhejiang's coast, more than 3,800 fishing boats returned to harbour, offshore fish-farm workers were brought ashore and 2,084 island visitors were evacuated, state media reported. Authorities halted 25 offshore construction projects and suspended 18 passenger ferry routes.

item.title: Mavericks beat Pacers as Cooper Flagg leaves with shoulder soreness
item.description: Kyrie Irving scored a game-high 24 points as the Mavericks defeated the Indiana Pacers 121-105 on Friday in Indianapolis, but the victory was overshadowed by a left shoulder injury to Dallas' Cooper Flagg.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Kyrie Irving scored a game-high 24 points as the Mavericks defeated the Indiana Pacers 121-105 on Friday in Indianapolis, but the victory was overshadowed by a left shoulder injury to Dallas' Cooper Flagg. With 59.7 seconds left in the second quarter, Aaron Nesmith challenged Flagg's dunk attempt from behind, sending Flagg sprawling. After a review, Nesmith was assessed a flagrant-1 foul. Naji Marshall rushed in and shoved Nesmith, and both players were assessed technical fouls. Dallas carried a 77-43 lead into the locker room, but Flagg, who had 14 points, five rebounds and six assists, did not return for the second half due to left shoulder soreness. P.J. Washington added 20 points and 13 rebounds for the Mavericks, while Max Christie scored 16, Marshall had 15 and Zaccharie Risacher contributed 11 points. Pascal Siakam paced Indiana with 23 points and Tyrese Haliburton, who missed all of last season after tearing his right Achilles in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals, added 18 points in his first home game in 491 days. Andrew Nembhard scored 16 points for the Pacers. Obi Toppin contributed 13 points, and Ivica Zubac grabbed 11 rebounds. Each team ended the game with a 1-1 record. Dallas built a 30-17 lead on a 14-2 run, capped by Irving's layup with 3:27 left in the first quarter. Irving and Flagg hit back-to-back threes, giving Dallas a 43-25 lead as the first quarter wound down. Dallas extended its lead to 50-31 when Marshall stole the ball from Siakam and fed Risacher for a one-handed dunk with 7:55 left in the second quarter. The Mavericks eventually stretched the margin to 30 points during a 15-0 run. Toppin's three-point play capped an 8-0 Pacers run that cut their deficit to 85-62 with 4:22 left in the third quarter. Toppin's dunk cut the deficit to 106-90 with 7:38 remaining, and Haliburton's jumper trimmed it to 118-105 with 1:56 left. Dallas finished without Irving, who fouled out with 4:23 to go. --Field Level Media

item.title: Scottie Barnes, RJ Barrett fuel Raptors past Wizards
item.description: Scottie Barnes collected 28 points and 14 rebounds and RJ Barrett added 23 and nine, respectively, lifting the visiting Toronto Raptors to a 112-102 victory over the Washington Wizards on Friday.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Scottie Barnes collected 28 points and 14 rebounds and RJ Barrett added 23 and nine, respectively, lifting the visiting Toronto Raptors to a 112-102 victory over the Washington Wizards on Friday. Barnes made 12 of 26 shots from the floor to offset eight turnovers for the Raptors, who never trailed in the contest and improved to 2-0. Kawhi Leonard recorded 16 points and nine rebounds and Immanuel Quickley added 12 points and six assists for Toronto. The Raptors shot 43.6% from the floor and enjoyed a decisive 52-32 edge in points in the paint. Trae Young highlighted his 22-point, 12-assist performance by draining four 3-pointers, with his last cutting Washington's deficit to 94-89 with 8:04 to play. Toronto responded with an 11-3 run, with Barrett making a pair of driving layups and an 18-foot jumper in that stretch. Washington countered by scoring five straight points before Leonard made a pair of baskets and Barnes converted a three-point play to effectively seal the win. Kyshawn George had 11 points on 2-of-9 shooting while committing eight of the Wizards' 23 turnovers. Washington's AJ Dybantsa, the top overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft, sat out his second straight game with a sprained left ankle as the Wizards fell to 1-1. Barnes' dunk extended Toronto's lead to 76-66 with 2:50 remaining in the third quarter before Young sank his third 3-pointer of the evening, igniting an 11-2 run. Justin Champagnie had a pair of layups and converted an alley-oop dunk during that sequence before Jamison Battle drilled a 3-pointer just before the end of the quarter for Toronto. The Raptors put the game on ice by outscoring the Wizards by a 31-25 margin in the fourth quarter. George sank a pair of free throws to cut Toronto's lead to 16-11 with 4:32 remaining in the first before the Raptors responded with an 18-10 run to end the quarter. Barnes drained two jumpers and a 3-pointer during the late surge. --Field Level Media

item.title: Hot-shooting Hawks set franchise mark with 47-point rout of Hornets
item.description: Jalen Johnson and reserve Aaron Wiggins each scored 19 points as visiting Atlanta blew out the Charlotte Hornets 128-81 on Friday, the biggest margin of victory in Hawks history.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jalen Johnson and reserve Aaron Wiggins each scored 19 points as visiting Atlanta blew out the Charlotte Hornets 128-81 on Friday, the biggest margin of victory in Hawks history. The 47-point gap topped the old record of 46 points set in a 126-80 victory over the visiting Sacramento Kings on Nov 15, 2017. Nickeil Alexander-Walker put up 14 points, CJ McCollum posted 13 points, Dyson Daniels contributed 11 points and nine rebounds and Corey Kispert also had 11 points for Atlanta, which won its second game in a row to start the season. Onyeka Okongwu added 10 points as the Hawks shot 50.5% from the field. Johnson supplied eight assists. It was a miserable home opener for the Hornets, who won two nights earlier at Brooklyn to start their campaign. They committed 27 turnovers. Naz Reid scored 17 points for Charlotte and Grayson Allen came off the bench for 11 points. Both players were in their home debuts with the Hornets. Reserve Tidjane Salaun also scored 11 points. The Hawks were efficient on offense throughout the game. The gap reached 97-62 by the end of the third quarter. The Hornets couldn't even get it cranked up when the margin was out of hand, needing about 6 1/2 minutes to reach a double-digit total in the fourth quarter. Wiggins, who shot 7-for-9 from the field, hit 3 of 5 from 3-point range. Charlotte's Brandon Miller finished 2-for-14 from the field, including 1-for-11 on 3-point tries. He scored six points. The Hornets didn't apply much pressure, not attempting a 10th free throw until deep into the fourth quarter. Atlanta built a 15-point first-quarter lead. It was 33-20 through the opening quarter, with the Hornets willing to fire away from the perimeter. Charlotte was 2-for-15 on first-quarter 3-point attempts. The Hawks poured it on in the second quarter to claim a 68-43 halftime lead on the strength of Wiggins' 15 points along with 13 points apiece from Johnson and McCollum. Atlanta benefited from Charlotte's 14 first-half turnovers. The Hornets played again without injured Kon Knueppel (hamstring), Coby White (calf) and Grant Williams (hamstring). --Field Level Media

item.title: Ｆ１＝ハミルトンが現役続行の可能性示唆、アフリカでのレース開催計画受け
item.description: ［オースティン（米テキサス州） ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［オースティン（米テキサス州）　２２日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１で個人総合優勝７回を誇るルイス・ハミルトン（英国、フェラーリ）は２２日、ルワンダでのグランプリ（ＧＰ）開催が現役生活を長く続けていく原動力になり得ると語った。

Ｆ１は１３日、２０３０年代初頭から１０年間にわたりルワンダでＧＰを開催することで合意したことを発表した。

今季の総合首位につけるキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア、メルセデス）と共に今週末の米国ＧＰに向けた記者会見に出席したハミルトンは、アフリカＧＰの復活について、「アフリカでのレース開催が決まったことで、より長く現役を続けなければならなくなった。アフリカでレースをすることは、ずっと私の夢だった」と述べた。

来年１月に４２歳となるハミルトンは続けて、「コンディションを維持するために戦い続けなければならない。来年も良い結果を残し続けることができれば、このまま現役を続けていくつもりだ」とコメント。２０歳のアントネッリは「少なくとも最初のレースには出ないと」とハミルトンを鼓舞した。

Ｆ１史上初で唯一の黒人の王者であるハミルトンは、アフリカでのレース開催を長年にわたり訴え続けてきた。これまでの自身の取り組みについても語り、「私にとってアフリカはＧＰ開催にふさわしい場所だ。単に一つの国だけの問題ではなく、アフリカ大陸そのものにとって重要なことだ」と述べた。

item.title: Pentagon designates China-funded Confucius Institutes as US national security threat
item.description: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth accused China-funded Confucius Institutes of stealing intellectual property and spreading propaganda on American university campuses.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Pentagon designates China-funded Confucius Institutes as US national security threat

US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth accused China-funded Confucius Institutes of stealing intellectual property and spreading propaganda on American university campuses.

WASHINGTON: The US Defense Department has designated Chinese-funded cultural centers on university campuses known as Confucius Institutes as a threat to the United States' national security, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Friday (Oct 23). Washington has long accused Confucius Institutes of being Chinese propaganda tools and has taken steps to crack down on them. Hegseth, in a video posted on social media, alleged that Confucius Institutes were operating under disguise at US universities and that the Pentagon had added them to its list of institutions that threaten US national security. "It turns out that 80 new propaganda cells across 30 universities had popped up using different names and different charters, but with the same mission: to steal intellectual property and to infiltrate the minds of American students," Hegseth said.

The Defense Department over the past two months has "systematically dismantled every single one of these organisations," he said. The Chinese embassy in Washington did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

China says US should stop discriminatory measures against Chinese research institutions

item.title: ＥＵ、貿易赤字削減へ中国との対話重視 化学品や機械などの輸入抑制模索
item.description: ［ダブリン ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ダブリン　２３日　ロイター］ - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）の閣僚らは２３日、域内経済に打撃を与えている対中貿易赤字の削減に向けて化学品や機械などの製品の輸入を抑制することを目指し、中国政府との対話に注力すべきとの認識で一致した。

シェフチョビッチ欧州委員（通商担当）は今月、中国からのハイブリッド車の輸入を半分超削減することで中国政府と合意した。１日当たり１０億ユーロ（１１億２０００万ドル）超に膨らんだ対中貿易赤字に対処するとともに、苦境にある欧州自動車メーカーを支援する。

アイルランドのマッケンティー外相はダブリンでの閣僚会合後の会見で、欧州委員会が中国との対話を継続すべきだという点で、ＥＵ加盟国全てが一致していると説明。「ハイブリッド車以外に、化学品や機械など他の分野に目を向けたいという非常に明確な意向がある」と語った。その上で、対話が優先事項である一方、不均衡を解消するために既存の貿易防衛手段を活用することも可能だと指摘した。

シェフチョビッチ氏は、プラスチックのセーフガード（緊急輸入制限）に関する調査が次に開始される見通しだと述べた。「調査開始に必要な要件が全てそろっているかどうかを検討している」とした。

item.title: OpenAI bloquea el acceso a internet de sus modelos de IA más avanzados durante el entrenamiento
item.description: La decisión llega tras incidentes en los que modelos de IA de OpenAI lograron conectarse a la web y vulnerar la seguridad de sistemas de terceros, incluida la plataforma Hugging Face.
item.dc:creator: Rachel Metz
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — OpenAI comenzó a bloquear el acceso a Internet de sus modelos de inteligencia artificial más avanzados durante el proceso de entrenamiento, como respuesta a incidentes anteriores en los que sus sistemas vulneraron la seguridad de otras empresas. La empresa afirmó el viernes en una entrada de blog que, tras una pausa el mes pasado, había reanudado el entrenamiento de sus modelos más avanzados, pero que tiene la intención de bloquear el acceso a Internet hasta que considere que dispone de las medidas de seguridad adecuadas para mitigar el riesgo de que los modelos aún no publicados puedan llevar a cabo acciones no autorizadas en línea durante el entrenamiento. “Teniendo en cuenta el estado actual de la investigación sobre alineación, los sistemas de supervisión y la seguridad de la infraestructura de Internet, creemos que el enfoque responsable consiste en llevar a cabo el entrenamiento de modelos de vanguardia sin acceso a Internet”, escribió la empresa. Ver más: OpenAI apuntaría a una valoración de US$1,25 billones en nueva ronda de US$30.000 millones A finales de septiembre, la empresa anunció que suspendería el entrenamiento de sus modelos de IA más avanzados tras descubrir que uno de sus sistemas de agentes de IA, que se estaba entrenando en lo que se suponía que era un entorno seguro y sin conexión a Internet, había logrado acceder a la web para conectarse con un chatbot externo de terceros. En aquel momento, OpenAI describió esta fuga como el primer incidente de seguridad de este tipo desde que, en julio, una combinación de modelos obtuviera acceso a Internet durante unas pruebas internas y violara inadvertidamente la seguridad de la plataforma de IA Hugging Face. Los modelos implicados en la filtración involuntaria de Hugging Face funcionaban sin las medidas de seguridad habituales, según ha declarado la empresa, ya que OpenAI tenía la intención de que permanecieran en un área de pruebas conocida como sandbox —esencialmente, un entorno de software virtual aislado destinado a realizar pruebas de seguridad o analizar código inseguro de forma controlada—. Sin embargo, los modelos lograron escapar de ese sandbox aprovechando una vulnerabilidad del software para acceder a Internet. Ver más: OpenAI se compromete a no usar secretos comerciales de Apple durante una audiencia clave OpenAI ha señalado que, tras el incidente de Hugging Face, redujo las conexiones a través de las cuales sus modelos podían acceder a Internet durante el entrenamiento y las pruebas, aunque mantuvo algunas con fines de métricas, registro y autenticación. Asimismo, dedicó una enorme cantidad de potencia de cálculo a encargar a sistemas de IA agentiva la identificación de vulnerabilidades en sus entornos de entrenamiento, como parte de una iniciativa de “red teaming”, una expresión que suele utilizarse para describir los intentos deliberados de infiltrarse en sistemas con el fin de descubrir vulnerabilidades antes de que lo hagan los atacantes reales. “Nuestros agentes del “red team” detectaron vulnerabilidades en casi todos estos servicios que les proporcionaban formas limitadas de acceso a Internet", señaló la empresa en su publicación. Ver más: OpenAI se disculpa por hackeo en Australia y promete informar más rápido sobre estos casos La empresa señaló que, desde entonces, ha implementado parches de software, ha impuesto restricciones de red más estrictas y ha comunicado los hallazgos a los proveedores. En los últimos meses se han producido una serie de revelaciones por parte de OpenAI y de sus competidores, entre ellos Anthropic PBC, sobre incidentes en los que sus modelos llevaron a cabo ataques autónomos o acciones no autorizadas en sitios web y sistemas de terceros. Estos casos, junto con una serie de severas advertencias procedentes del propio sector, han situado el debate sobre la seguridad en el centro de la atención pública. Los desarrolladores de IA han advertido de que sus sistemas podrían llegar pronto a ser demasiado sofisticados para que las personas puedan controlarlos, lo que se suma a la preocupación de que la tecnología pueda ser utilizada por actores humanos malintencionados para crear armas biológicas o llevar a cabo ciberataques devastadores. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: UK's Healey to give two state-backed lenders £20 billion capital boost in budget
item.description: British finance minister John Healey is expected to announce £20.4 billion ($27.3 billion) of additional support to the state's business lender and infrastructure bank in his budget on Wednesday, the Treasury said, confirming a newspaper report.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: British finance minister John Healey is expected to announce £20.4 billion ($27.3 billion) of additional support to the state's business lender and infrastructure bank in his budget on Wednesday, the Treasury said, confirming a newspaper report. The Treasury will allocate £15.4 billion ($20.6 billion) more to the National Wealth Fund and £5 billion ($7 billion) more to the British Business Bank over roughly half a decade "This additional capital will help more British businesses fulfil their potential, while getting investment behind the industries, infrastructure and places that create good jobs and drive lasting growth across the country," a Treasury spokesperson said in an emailed statement The Treasury said the funding would help support around 100,000 jobs by 2035 in sectors including artificial intelligence, defence and green energy The Financial Times first reported the news ($1 = 0.7478 pounds)

item.title: Iran has detailed plans to hit Gulf undersea cables if war resumes, officials say
item.description: Their comments followed warnings by Iranian officials that undersea cables in the region could become targets in any renewed conflict if diplomacy with Washington collapses.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Iran has detailed plans to hit Gulf undersea cables if war resumes, officials say

Their comments followed warnings by Iranian officials that undersea cables in the region could become targets in any renewed conflict if diplomacy with Washington collapses.

Vessels at the Strait of Hormuz, as seen from Musandam, Oman, Oct 23, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Stringer)

DUBAI: Tehran has drawn up detailed plans to target undersea communications cables in the Gulf if the United States and Israel attack Iran again, two senior Iranian security officials told Reuters. Their comments followed warnings by Iranian officials that undersea cables in the region could become targets in any renewed conflict if diplomacy with Washington collapses. The two Iranian security officials, speaking on condition of anonymity, gave few details and did not say how or where exactly Tehran would carry out such attacks. But one of them said Iran would aim to prevent repairs after any attacks to prolong disruptions to communications, including internet connections. "If Iran is attacked, there will be no more red lines ... from undersea cables to military bases, including covert ones," one of the officials said.

The official warned Washington not to "play with fire", and said Iran had full access to the undersea cables and could easily destroy them. Yadollah Javani, the deputy head of political affairs for Iran's Revolutionary Guards (IRGC), said on Wednesday (Oct 21) that Iran could target seven major internet cables beneath the Strait of Hormuz if Iranian infrastructure came under attack. Undersea cables carry around 99 per cent of global internet traffic, according to the International Telecommunication Union, a UN agency. But the global impact of such attacks by Iran could be limited as less than 1 per cent of international bandwidth passes through the Strait of Hormuz, said Alan Mauldin, research director at telecommunications research firm TeleGeography. The strait separates Iran and Oman, linking the Gulf to the Gulf of Oman and the Arabian Sea. The US Department of State and Iran's Foreign Ministry did not respond to Reuters' requests for comment on the Iranian security officials' remarks. There was no immediate comment from Gulf states.

Related:

US could strike Iran this weekend, envoy says

US orders diplomats to depart Saudi Arabia amid Houthi strikes

"STRONGER RESPONSE" The plans for possible attacks on undersea cables reflect a conviction in Iran's leadership that a renewed US military campaign would have to be met with a stronger response than before. Top security official Mohsen Rezaei warned this month that US-linked digital infrastructure across the Gulf, including data centres and AI facilities, could be targeted in a renewed conflict. Washington's Gulf allies have invested heavily in such infrastructure and they "should hold Washington, not Tehran, responsible for any damage to undersea cables," the second Iranian security official said. Alex Vatanka, director of the Iran program at the Middle East Institute in Washington, said such threats were intended to deter renewed conflict and put pressure on Washington by making Gulf governments and US companies fear for their investments in the region. "Tehran wants Gulf states and corporate executives to press (US President Donald) Trump over the risks his policies pose to their investment plans," said Vatanka. Multiple cable cuts could slow internet services and disrupt financial transactions, e-commerce and cloud computing, analysts said. The impact would depend on how operators rerouted traffic and the capacity available on alternative connections, Mauldin said. Restoring connections during wartime could be difficult, experts said, and higher insurance costs and delays in obtaining permits to enter territorial waters could further complicate repairs. The Red Sea could offer a more significant target than the Strait of Hormuz, particularly if Iran had support from its Houthi allies in Yemen, though Tehran has made no public statement indicating it plans to target cables there. The Red Sea carries data between Europe, East Africa and Asia, with capacity routed through it accounting for about 3 per cent of global international demand and around 10 per cent of traffic travelling between regions, Mauldin said. Gulf governments have been investing heavily in technology to diversify beyond oil and become global artificial intelligence hubs, deepening ties with US technology firms. Iranian strikes directly hit two Amazon Web Services facilities in the UAE in March and damaged infrastructure near one of its facilities in Bahrain. The IRGC named US tech companies including Microsoft, Google, Apple and Nvidia as legitimate targets at the height of the war in March. Land-based connections can provide alternative routes for internet traffic, and Gulf states and US technology companies are investing in additional infrastructure to improve resilience. Microsoft plans to invest more than US$400 million in subsea and terrestrial connectivity across the Middle East by 2030.

Source: Reuters/gs

item.title: Ｆ１＝米国ＧＰフリー走行、ルクレールが最速ラップ
item.description: ［オースティン（米テキサス州） ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［オースティン（米テキサス州）　２３日　ロイター］ - 自動車レースＦ１の今季第１８戦、米国グランプリ（ＧＰ）は２３日、米テキサス州オースティンでフリー走行を行い、フェラーリのシャルル・ルクレール（モナコ）がこの日のトップタイムを記録した。

フリー走行１回目に最速１分３６秒０５２を記録したルクレールは、２回目でトップタイムの１分３５秒２９１をマークした。

今週末の結果次第でＦ１史上最年少王者となるメルセデスのキミ・アントネッリ（イタリア）が０秒０４２差で２番手。昨年の米国ＧＰを制したレッドブルのマックス・フェルスタッペン（オランダ）がルクレールと０秒１８９差で３番手に入った。

４番手はフェラーリのルイス・ハミルトンで、メルセデスのジョージ・ラッセル（ともに英国）が５番手で続いた。現王者でマクラーレンのランド・ノリス（英国）は、レーシングブルズのリアム・ローソン（ニュージーランド）に続く７番手となった。

item.title: US has for years asked Musk to alter Starlink service in Ukraine, Middle East, sources say
item.description: The Biden-era and Trump requests to Musk show a close relationship in which US administrations rely to an unprecedented degree on a private-sector company to help implement foreign policy.
item.dc:creator: Erin Banco, Joey Roulette
item.content:encoded: Well before the throttling this month of Ukraine's military access to Elon Musk's satellite communications system, the Biden and Trump administrations had several times asked SpaceX to turn its Starlink service on or off in various countries, according to six former senior US officials familiar with the matter. During the presidency of Joe Biden, the requests included switching off the service to prevent Iranian proxy militias in Yemen and Lebanon from using Starlink to communicate, and activating the service to provide internet access inside Iran and in Ukraine to support its military, said four of the former officials. Similarly, President Donald Trump's administration asked Musk, who is CEO of SpaceX, to make the service available in Iran following US-Israeli strikes in 2025 and 2026, in hopes it would bolster internet access and communications for anti-government protesters, a former senior Trump official and a person familiar with the matter told Reuters. All of the people spoke on condition of anonymity. The previous US requests about Starlink access are being reported here for the first time. The recent blowup over restrictions to Ukraine's use of SpaceX satellite services has raised questions about the ties between the US government and Musk, whose company owns systems vital to the US military and to US allies. The Biden-era and Trump requests to Musk show a close relationship in which US administrations rely to an unprecedented degree on a private-sector company to help implement foreign policy. The recent limits on Ukraine, despite being a US ally, have also rattled officials in Europe, some of whom argue that Europe must develop its own military satellite communications capabilities because no viable short-term alternative currently exists. STARSHIELD RESTRICTIONS HOBBLE UKRAINE MILITARY Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said last week that his country's access to Starshield, the military version of the Starlink system, had been intentionally limited, interfering with the performance of the country’s military drones. He also said the speeds were reduced for Starlink, which Ukraine uses for some military activities including defense against Russian missile attacks. Reuters has reported that [USN:L1N4610ZC TEXT:"the order to throttle Starshield"] came from inside the White House. The Trump administration has acknowledged the slowdown but has not said whether it gave the order. The White House, contacted for comment, referred Reuters to Trump's remarks on Friday, when he said he had not spoken with Musk about Starlink access issues for Ukraine and that "if there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out." Halyna Yusypiuk, a spokesperson for the Ukrainian embassy in Washington, said Ukraine's priority is "to have the service restored to normal speed as soon as possible, as the lives of our people depend on it." SpaceX did not respond to requests for comment, although Musk said in a social media post earlier this week: “Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately (by the president of the United States).” Democratic US Representative Jason Crow called on Friday for clarity about the recent changes to Ukraine's satellite service, saying there are risks to the US dependence on SpaceX. "Unelected billionaires and private corporations should not decide what is in the best interest of America's national security," Crow said. For Ukraine, the Starlink internet service has become the lifeblood of frontline communication between units, who say there is currently no rival to the capabilities of SpaceX's products. Starshield receivers, largely impervious to radio jamming, are used as onboard guidance systems and to provide links to a remote pilot for Ukrainian drones, including deep behind Russian lines inside Ukraine. MUSK'S INFLUENCE RAISES UNCERTAINTY Musk's role as the strong-willed CEO of a company with outsized influence over US national security has at times raised questions over who is making decisions about SpaceX's satellite services. The SpaceX CEO is "supposed to be a business executive, with government contracts, and he's essentially making huge foreign policy decisions," said Armand Musey, president of Summit Ridge Group, a satellite industry consultancy. "He's sufficiently ambiguous of a person that you don't know if his decisions are sort of his personal quirks, or it's because there's an influence elsewhere that's impacting him," Musey said. In previous years, Musk has moved to limit Ukraine’s access to Starlink. In 2022, according to Reuters reporting , Musk ordered SpaceX personnel to cut Starlink coverage in areas Ukraine was trying to retake, a move that surprised White House officials. Musk has said publicly that he refused a 2022 Ukrainian request to activate his satellite network in Crimea's port city of Sevastopol to aid an attack on Russia's fleet there, saying he feared complicity in a major act of war. The Biden administration at times relied on Musk to help implement policy, five of the former officials said. Biden officials coordinated with SpaceX to thwart US adversaries by cutting the service, and to help allies by expanding Starlink’s availability, they said. They added that discussions between the government and SpaceX, which usually included Pentagon and White House officials, often focused on preventing groups such as the Iranian-linked Houthis in Yemen and Hezbollah in Lebanon from using Starlink terminals. Biden officials several times shared intelligence with SpaceX that indicated that the Houthis and Hezbollah were using diverted Starlink terminals — hardware that made its way to the militants through intermediaries. In October 2023, during fighting between Israel and Hezbollah militants in southern Lebanon, intelligence officials told the White House that individuals linked to Hezbollah could have gained access to Starlink terminals. Officials had similar concerns about the Houthis in Yemen in 2024 during a US air campaign against the Iran-linked group, five of the officials said. In both cases, the administration contacted SpaceX and asked it to identify the terminals and shut them off. At least some of the terminals were deactivated, said two of the officials. In a 2024 submission to the US Commerce Department's Bureau of Industry and Security, SpaceX said it works closely with US government agencies to secure export authorizations where required and to safeguard technology in support of US national security objectives and foreign policy goals. Soon after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Biden officials pushed SpaceX to expand Starlink use for the Ukrainian military, said two of the former officials. In a separate instance, the Biden administration asked SpaceX to turn on Starlink in Iran during a protest movement launched in September 2022 after the death of Mahsa Amini, an Iranian arrested for not wearing her hijab properly, according to one of the former officials. Starlink terminals were moved into the country with the help of the administration, said the official, who declined to say how many were transferred. The Trump administration took a similar step earlier this year and discussed with Musk and SpaceX getting Starlink terminals into Iran and activated following US-Israeli strikes in the country in June 2025 and again in February 2026, a former senior Trump official and a person familiar with the matter told Reuters. Neither the Trump administration nor SpaceX has publicly confirmed that those terminals were turned on. The Wall Street Journal reported in February that the US government had sent thousands of Starlink terminals into Iran. Iran's delegation to the UN did not respond to a request for comment.

item.title: サッカー＝伊藤所属バイエルンのコンパニ監督、練習中に倒れ病院に搬送
item.description: ［ミュンヘン（ドイツ） ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ミュンヘン（ドイツ）　２３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガで伊藤洋輝が所属するバイエルン・ミュンヘンは２３日、バンサン・コンパニ監督が練習中に倒れ、病院に搬送されたと発表した。

コンパニ監督は最近、ウイルス感染症を患い、チームの練習を何度か欠席していた。クラブの発表によると、同監督はセカンドチームの練習を見学中に倒れ、医療処置を受けた。現在は病院で精密検査を受けており、引き続き医師の管理下に置かれる。当面はコーチ陣が練習や試合の指揮を執るという。

バイエルンはドイツ１部で首位に立っており、今週行われた欧州チャンピオンズリーグ（ＣＬ）ではアーセナル（イングランド）とホームで２─２の引き分け。２５日には鈴木唯人、山本理仁、後藤啓介が所属するフライブルクと敵地で対戦する予定となっている。

item.title: サッカー＝サウジでのアジア杯開催、治安情勢受け困難か 宮本会長が見解
item.description: ［東京 ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［東京　２３日　ロイター］ - 日本サッカー協会の宮本恒靖会長は２３日、サウジアラビアの治安情勢を踏まえ、来年のアジア・カップ（杯）を予定通り同国で開催するのは容易ではないとの認識を示した。

サウジではイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃が激化する中、主要なスポーツイベントの中止や延期が相次いでいる。来年１月７日から２月５日まで予定されているアジア杯の開催にも不透明感が広がっている。

宮本会長は東京で開かれたアジア・サッカー連盟（ＡＦＣ）の臨時総会で記者団に対し、報道を通じて把握している限りでは現地の安全が確保されておらず、現時点での開催は難しいとの見方を示した。

また、サウジ側との会談では、選手やファン、大会関係者らの安全を最優先する方針が伝えられたと説明。サウジ側からは、開催の可否をＡＦＣと協議して判断するため、結論が出るまでには時間がかかるとの説明もあったという。

ＡＦＣ会長は先週、必要であれば大会を２０２８年に延期する可能性もあると述べたが、その後、地元大会組織委員会は当初の日程通り開催する方針を示していた。

item.title: フランス格下げ回避、ムーディーズが据え置き決定 社会不安続く中
item.description: ［パリ ２３日 ロイター］ - 格付け会社ムーディーズは２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いた。社会不安の抑制と厳...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
フランス格下げ回避、ムーディーズが据え置き決定　社会不安続く中 9:20 配信

22日、パリで学生団体や労働組合が主催した抗議行動の最中、警戒にあたるフランス機動隊（ＣＲＳ）の隊員たち　REUTERS/Abdul Saboor

［パリ　２３日　ロイター］ - 格付け会社ムーディーズは２３日、フランスの信用格付けを据え置いた。社会不安の抑制と厳しい財政の立て直しに苦慮する政府にとって、圧力が和らいだ格好だ。

ムーディーズは格付けの定期見直しを終え、「Ａａ３」に据え置いたと発表した。見通しは２０２５年１０月以降、「ネガティブ」としている。

債券市場は格下げを織り込んでいた。格下げされれば、既に格下げしていたＳ＆Ｐ、フィッチにムーディーズも足並みをそろえる形になるところだった。フランスでは２４年の解散総選挙でどの勢力も議会の過半数を確保できず、政治がまひ状態に陥り、財政再建が難航している。

仏財務省は声明で、格付け据え置きは「政府が２７年予算法案で示した予算の信頼性を反映している。この予算は、財政再建の軌道を維持することを目指している」と表明した。

ムーディーズは声明で「Ａａ３の格付けは、財政赤字の削減を盛り込んだ２７年予算が成立し、今後数カ月で資金調達コストが幾分低下し、社会的緊張もやや緩和することを前提としている」と説明した。

item.title: ゴルフ＝ＢＭＷ女子選手権、岩井千と吉田が6位 首位と4打差
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - 米女子ゴルフのＢＭＷ女子選手権は２３日、韓国南西部・海南のパインビーチ・リンクス（パー７２）で第２ラウンドを行い、岩井千怜と吉田優利が通算９アンダーの１３５で６位につけた。

前日首位の吉田は４バーディー、１ボギーの６９で回り、６位に後退。首位とは４打差となった。８位スタートだった岩井千怜は２イーグル、５バーディー、１ボギー、１ダブルボギーの６６をマークした。

２９位で出た岩井明愛は６７で回り、通算６アンダーの１３８で１５位に浮上。前日１８位の畑岡奈紗は６９をマークし、通算５アンダーの１３９で２３位に後退した。

勝みなみは４５位、古江彩佳は５６位、竹田麗央は７５位、原英莉花は８０位だった。

ユ・ヘラン（韓国）が２イーグル、４バーディーの６４、通算１３アンダーの１３１として首位に浮上。ローレン・コフリン（米国）らが２打差の２位で追いかけている。

item.title: サッカー＝町野が得点、宇野が初アシスト ボルシアＭＧは初白星
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - サッカーのドイツ１部ブンデスリーガは２３日、１試合を行い、町野修斗が今季２ゴール目を挙げたボルシアＭＧは敵地でシュツットガルトに３─２で勝利した。

町野と橋岡大樹、宇野禅斗の日本人３選手が先発したボルシアＭＧは、前半５分に先制を許す。それでも、同３８分には宇野がボレーシュートを放つと、ゴール前のジョー・スカリーが右足ヒールでコースを変えてネットを揺らし、同点に追いついた。宇野は今夏のチーム加入後初アシスト。

さらにボルシアＭＧは後半６分、味方の折り返しから正面の町野が左足でシュートを沈めて逆転。チームは同２１分にも追加点を奪ってリードを広げると、その後に１点を返されるも逃げ切った。

リーグ開幕から６連敗だったボルシアＭＧは、７戦目で初白星。橋岡と宇野がフル出場し、町野は後半３９分までプレーした。板倉滉はメンバー外だった。

item.title: 陸上＝競歩の池田、ドーピング違反処分取り消し 競技復帰可能に
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - スポーツ仲裁裁判所（ＣＡＳ）は２３日、陸上男子２０キロ競歩で２０２１年東京五輪銀メダリストの池田向希（２８）に科されていた４年間の資格停止処分を取り消すと発表した。ドーピング違反が立証されなかったとして池田の不服申し立てを認め、ただちに競技復帰が可能となった。

池田は選手の血液データを蓄積する「生体パスポート」の数値に異常が見られたことからドーピングを疑われ、２４年１１月に暫定的な資格停止処分を受けた。２５年２月には世界陸連から４年間の資格停止処分を科された。

一貫してドーピングを否定してきた池田は同年３月にＣＡＳへ不服を申し立て、今年５月にスイスのローザンヌで聴聞会が開かれた。

ＣＡＳは生体パスポートの複数の数値に異常があったことを認めた一方、ドーピング以外の合理的な説明が可能と判断。池田側が提出した医学的証拠や専門家の意見により、世界陸連の裁定機関による審理時よりも幅広い事実関係が明らかになったとし、違反は立証されていないと結論付けた。

池田は２２年世界選手権でも銀メダルを獲得し、２４年パリ五輪では７位だった。今回の裁定により、２８年ロサンゼルス五輪への出場にも道が開けた。

item.title: ゴルフ＝バミューダ選手権、首位浮上の平田「久しぶりの優勝争い」
item.description: ［２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［２３日　ロイター］ - 米男子ゴルフのバミューダ選手権は２３日、英領バミューダ、サウサンプトンのポートロイヤルＧＣ（パー７１）で第２ラウンドを行い、平田憲聖が首位に浮上した。

前日１１位の平田は７バーディー、ノーボギーの６４をマークし、通算１３アンダーの１２９でトップに立った。「久しぶりの優勝争いなので、週末はいろいろな感情が湧いてくると思うが、これまでの６勝が助けになると思う」とコメント。同選手は日本ツアーで６勝を挙げている。

１１位スタートの米沢蓮は３アンダーの６８で回り、通算９アンダーの１３３で１３位に後退。初日は６バーディー、ノーボギーの６５を記録していた。金谷拓実は６３位。

前日首位のチャンドラー・ブランシェ（米国）は最終１８番でバーディーを奪うなど、４アンダーの６７をマークし、平田と並ぶ首位を維持した。

item.title: Moderna y Merck enfrentan dudas de inversionistas pese a los avances de su vacuna contra el melanoma
item.description: La vacuna personalizada redujo un 42% el riesgo de recurrencia del melanoma y un 38% el de diseminación a distancia. Sin embargo, los datos filtrados generaron dudas entre los inversionistas sobre su ...
item.dc:creator: Michelle Fay Cortez, Robert Langreth
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Los datos filtrados del tan esperado ensayo clínico de la vacuna contra el melanoma de Moderna Inc. ( MRNA ) y Merck & Co. ( MRK ) han generado una inusual discrepancia entre los médicos, que celebraron sus resultados, y Wall Street, donde se produjo una venta masiva de acciones. Normalmente, los resultados de este tipo de ensayos clínicos decisivos son binarios: médicos, pacientes e inversores descubren si un nuevo medicamento marcará una diferencia significativa en la vida de las personas y llegan a la misma conclusión. En cambio, a medida que se filtraban en las redes sociales informes sobre los resultados de la vacuna contra el melanoma, días antes de la presentación cuidadosamente preparada que tenía previsto ofrecer ante miles de oncólogos reunidos en Madrid con motivo del congreso de la Sociedad Europea de Oncología Médica, esas realidades divergieron. Ver más: Moderna cae un récord de 26% tras filtrarse datos de su vacuna contra el melanoma con Merck La vacuna personalizada contra el cáncer desarrollada por Moderna y Merck ayudó claramente a los pacientes, reduciendo en un 42% la probabilidad de que sus tumores reaparecieran tras su extirpación quirúrgica y previniendo su diseminación a distancia en un 38%. Sin embargo, las acciones de ambas farmacéuticas cayeron, y la caída de Moderna alcanzó niveles récord durante la sesión bursátil de este jueves. Los resultados suponen un gran avance para el melanoma, uno de los tipos de cáncer más comunes, y podrían constituir una nueva y potente herramienta para tratar numerosas formas operables de la enfermedad. La vacuna podría ayudar a muchos miles de personas con melanoma que presentan un alto riesgo de recidiva. Este tipo de resultados suelen sentar las bases para la aprobación de nuevos medicamentos, y los médicos acogieron con satisfacción los hallazgos. “Estoy bastante impresionado”, aseguró Michael Postow, especialista en melanoma del Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center y uno de los investigadores. Los beneficios podrían incrementar con el tiempo, señaló. “Es probable que, hasta ahora, no hayamos visto el efecto terapéutico completo de todo esto”. Incluso tras la caída de este jueves, las acciones de Moderna siguen estando muy por encima del nivel en el que se encontraban antes de que la compañías anunciara en agosto que la vacuna era eficaz, sin presentar el conjunto completo de datos. Wall Street, no obstante, ha revisado a la baja algunas de sus expectativas más optimistas respecto a la empresa biotecnológica tras la publicación de esta semana. Había descontado la idea de que la vacuna fuera el punto de partida de una línea oncológica más amplia que Moderna ha estado tratando de desarrollar, y que algún día podría incluir tratamientos similares para el cáncer de pulmón, de vejiga y otros tipos de cáncer. Los datos limitados han suscitado ciertas dudas sobre lo difícil que resultaría ello, al mostrar que la capacidad para prevenir la diseminación a distancia podría no ser tan sólida como se esperaba. La información disponible no ha infundido confianza en algunos inversionistas de Moderna, que apostaban por el giro de la empresa tras la Covid-19 para convertirse en una importante empresa dedicada al cáncer. “Aunque la aprobación parece probable, el éxito comercial es mucho menos seguro”, escribió Trung Huynh, analista de RBC Capital Markets, en una nota dirigida a los inversionistas. Los datos plantean “cuestiones fundamentales” sobre la propuesta de valor de la vacuna en comparación con el tratamiento de referencia actual, que ofrece beneficios similares a un coste potencialmente mucho menor, señaló. Ver más: Moderna se dispara 160% y deja millonarias pérdidas a quienes apostaban por su caída El éxito de la vacuna contra el melanoma también someterá a Moderna y Merck a la presión de completar los ensayos en otros tipos de cáncer, incluso cuando surgen dudas sobre las ventas a corto plazo y el mercado potencialmente más amplio para dicha tecnología. “Se trata de una forma extraordinariamente compleja y potencialmente costosa de fabricar fármacos”, afirmó Lennard Lee, profesor asociado de la Universidad de Oxford. “La logística podría hacer que Amazon pareciera sencilla”. Todos los pacientes del estudio recibieron además Keytruda, el fármaco oncológico más vendido de Merck, lo que convierte a las vacunas personalizadas diseñadas para cada paciente en una terapia complementaria. Los beneficios adicionales, junto con la ausencia de efectos secundarios graves, podrían convencer a más pacientes de optar por este tratamiento, señaló Sekwon Jang, director de investigación y terapias contra el melanoma e investigador clínico del Inova Schar Cancer Institute, en el norte de Virginia. Ver más: FDA aprueba medicamento contra cáncer de piel avanzado para pacientes sin respuesta a inmunoterapia “Con esta combinación, creo que la relación riesgo-beneficio es, de hecho, mucho más favorable”, explicó Jang. “Espero que más pacientes míos opten por recibir este tratamiento combinado”, agregó, si finalmente se aprueba. No obstante, los inversionistas ya esperaban resultados sólidos después de que las empresas emitieran un comunicado de prensa en agosto en el que se indicaba que el estudio había tenido éxito, y algo más. Esa noticia avivó las expectativas respecto al uso de la tecnología de ARNm de Moderna, diseñada para permitir a los médicos preparar el sistema inmunitario para detectar y destruir invasores extraños y otras amenazas, incluidas las células tumorales. Luego de décadas con resultados decepcionantes, estos hallazgos podrían suponer un real avance en el desarrollo de una vacuna contra el cáncer dirigida a los tumores sólidos. Aun así, los detalles de los resultados del estudio todavía no se han presentado en su totalidad a los médicos ni a los inversionistas, y se necesitan para evaluar su potencial y validar sus expectativas. Los resultados serán presentados este sábado en Madrid, donde un grupo más amplio de oncólogos evaluará los hallazgos. -Con la colaboración de Madison Muller. Lea más en Bloomberg

Oct 23 : Amazon CEO Andy Jassy said on Friday that Amazon Web Services' cloud computing capacity is largely sold out through 2027, with significant commitments extending into 2028, on growing demand for AI infrastructure. In a video podcast with Andreessen Horowitz co-founder Ben Horowitz and general partner Erik Torenberg, Jassy said Amazon is struggling to keep pace with the insatiable demand from AI labs and enterprises. • Earlier this year, Amazon had said it would spend about $220 billion in capital expenditure for 2026 • Jassy said the company "could invest a lot more and it wouldn't be a bad use of capital," considering cloud-computing capacity for 2026 is already sold out

LONDON, Oct 24 : Britain's government set out around £600 million ($800 million)of funding on Saturday largely geared towards defending against health and security threats from artificial intelligence. The biggest chunk of funding will go to a new biosecurity initiative, including £100 million for a laboratory using AI to detect biological threats and £65 million to develop countermeasures against pathogens. AI minister Kanishka Narayan said the aim was for the AI Biosecurity Lab to become a major global institution "bringing together world-leading scientific expertise to protect people from emerging biological threats". • Tech companies OpenAI and Anthropic will offer up to £200 million of model credits to the biosecurity initiative

FAST

AMSTERDAM, Oct 23 : The discovery of two serious flaws in PHP this week set off a global scramble to keep websites safe from hackers, showing just how critical the three-decade-old open-source programming language is to the internet. Yet the nonprofit foundation that supports PHP,  which may underpin up to 70 per cent of sites globally, operates on a shoestring budget.  “We have one full-time staff member (that's me) and 14 mostly part-time contractors,” Executive Director Elizabeth Barron of the PHP Foundation said via email in an interview on Friday. Board members are unpaid volunteers, and funding comes from donations and grants. The foundation works with outside researchers and companies, including OpenAI and cybersecurity firms Wiz and Calif, to investigate security flaws and coordinate fixes, including Wednesday's patches.

While Web security company Cloudflare has reported millions of hacking attempts, Barron said the foundation had no evidence hackers were able to exploit the vulnerabilities before they were disclosed, or on sites that have been patched. "We received no further indication from OpenAI, Wiz or Calif, with whom we're working closely on this issue, regarding any issues on patched systems,” she said. Artificial intelligence has proved both a help and a burden to the foundation. It helped researchers find the flaws, which had been present for a decade, and Barron said it made programmers more efficient. However, it is also increasing maintainers' workloads. The PHP project is receiving nearly twice as many proposed code changes as a year ago, “yet the number of contributors hasn't doubled,” she said. Reviewing contributions and bug reports requires “a massive amount of human input and experience.” Recent events have shown how heavily companies and governments rely on PHP, Barron said. “Given that reliance, it is clear that PHP is incredibly under-funded.”

Source: Reuters

item.title: イスラエル占領が「地域不安定化の主因」、エジプトなど4カ国外相が声明
item.description: [２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２３日 ロイター] - エジプト、サウジアラビア、トルコ、パキスタンの外相は２３日、イスタンブールでの会合後に発表した共同声明で、「イスラエルの占領が地域およびその周辺における不安定の主な原因だ」と述べ、二国家解決の早急な実施を求めた。

国営サウジ通信（ＳＰＡ）によると、外相らは、イスラエルの政策は「世界的な不公正感を一層深めた」と指摘。１９６７年以前の国境線に基づき、東エルサレムを首都とするパレスチナ国家樹立への支持を改めて表明した。

item.title: トルコ、フーシ派との戦闘「想定せず」 サウジとの防衛協定下でも＝国防相
item.description: [アンカラ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[アンカラ　２３日　ロイター] - トルコのギュレル国防相は２３日、サウジアラビアおよびパキスタンとの防衛協定に基づいて自国軍がイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派との戦闘に加わることは想定していないとの考えを示した。

ギュレル氏はスターテレビに対し「われわれはフーシ派とのいかなる衝突も想定していない」と述べ、サウジへのトルコの軍事支援は、カタールの場合と同様、主に抑止力の強化を目的とするものになると語った。

ギュレル氏は、トルコは議会が協定を批准した後、必要な法的手続きと議会の承認に従って、サウジからの軍事支援要請を評価し、支援の範囲を決定すると説明した。

８月に署名され、今週、批准に向けてトルコ議会に提出された「メッカ共同防衛協定」は、トルコ、サウジ、パキスタンの３カ国のいずれか１カ国への武力攻撃を全３カ国への攻撃と見なすことを定めている。

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（23日）ドル堅調、利回り上昇 主要3指数軒並み下落
item.description: ＜為替＞ ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。来週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（23日）ドル堅調、利回り上昇　主要3指数軒並み下落 6:13 配信

＜為替＞　ドルが円やユーロなどの主要通貨に対しやや上昇した。来週は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）、欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）、日銀が金融政策決定会合を開く。いずれも政策金利の据え置きが予想されているが、今後の金融政策の方向性の手がかりを示すか注目されている。    終盤の取引で、円は対ドルで０．１％安の１５６．９円。ただ、週間ベースでは円は対ドルで約０．７％上昇。９月中旬以来の大幅な上昇となる。ＭＵＦＧのシニア通貨アナリスト、リー・ハードマン氏は「リスク回避姿勢が強まる中、円買いが続いている」と述べた。    ユーロに対してはフランスの債務リスクプレミアムが２０１１年のユーロ圏債務危機以来の高水準に拡大したことなどが重しになっており、ユーロは対ドルで０．２１％安の１．１１９１ドル。週初からは０．４３％下落した。    ユーロは対円でより大きく下落し、一時１７５．０８円と、２０２５年１０月以来の安値を更新。週初からは約１．１％下落した。    フランスでは１７日の抗議デモが過去数十年で最大規模の暴動に発展してから１週間が経過し、ヌニェス内相は暴力行為や略奪の再発防止に向け、２４日に全国で予定される抗議活動に７万人の警察官を動員すると発表。パリのルーブル美術館、オルセー美術館、オペラ座などの主要文化施設の一部が臨時休館となるほか、治安上の懸念からパリで予定されているサッカーフランス１部リーグの試合が２５日から２６日に延期されるなどの影響が出ている。    終盤の取引で、主要通貨に対するドル指数は０．２５％高の１０１．８２。    ＦＲＢの金融政策を巡っては、前日の株式相場急落を受け、１２月の会合での利上げ観測がやや後退したことがＬＳＥＧのデータで示された。ただ、ＦＦ金利先物市場では１２月利上げの確率はなお８１％と見込まれている。    ＥＣＢについては、１２月の理事会で利上げが決定される確率は６６％と織り込まれている。ラガルドＥＣＢ総裁が９月下旬にインフレに対し穏健な政策対応が適切との認識を示していることから、今後の金利見通しについて新たな示唆があるか注目されている。    日銀については、１２月の利上げの確率が６１％と織り込まれている。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞　国債利回りが上昇した。ただそれでも、指標１０年債利回りは５％を下回る水準にとどまっている。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の上昇が持続するかどうかへの懸念がくすぶっていることが背景にある。    １０年債利回りは３．７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の４．９９％。週間では約１１ｂｐ低下しており、６月以来の長さとなる３週連続の低下に向かっている。    株式相場の強気局面を支えるＡＩ関連銘柄への投資の持続性を巡り、足元で懸念が浮上し、投資家は国債などの安全資産に資金を移している。    ３０年債利回りは２．９ｂｐ上昇の５．３１６％。ただ、週間では１３ｂｐ近く低下しており、こちらも３週連続の低下に向かっている。    経済指標が物価上昇圧力の強まりを示す一方、市場では米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が来週の米連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で利上げするとの見方が後退している。ＣＭＥのフェドウオッチによると、少なくとも２５ｂｐの利上げが行われる確率は９．４％と、１週間前の１５．５％、１カ月前の７０．９％から低下した。    経済見通しを示す指標として注目される２年債と１０年債の利回り格差は２９．６ｂｐだった。    ＦＲＢの金利見通しを反映しやすい２年債利回りは５．５ｂｐ上昇の４．６９％。週間では約５ｂｐ低下しており、２０２６年で最長となる４週連続の低下に向かっている。    物価連動国債（ＴＩＰＳ）と通常の国債の利回り差で、期待インフレを示すブレーク・イーブン・インフレ率（ＢＥＩ）は、５年物が２．４５６％、１０年物ＢＥＩは２．３４６％だった。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞　主要株価３指数が軒並み下落して取引を終えた。一方、ハイテク株は持ち直し、市場をけん引してきた人工知能（ＡＩ）関連銘柄にとって波乱の１週間を締めくくった。市場の関心は、来週予定される企業決算や連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）に移っている。

ハイテク株の比率が高いナスダック総合は小幅な下げにとどまった。前日は、巨額のＡＩ投資を支える資金調達コストへの懸念が強まり、１日として６月以来の大幅下落となっていた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種の大半のセクターが軟調で、一般消費財や金融はいずれも１％を大きく超える下げとなった。一方、エネルギーセクターは２．５％上昇し、過去最高値を付けた。サウジアラビアでのイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派による攻撃を受け、中東からのエネルギー供給が一段と混乱するとの懸念が高まり、北海ブレント原油はこの日、４月下旬以来の高値を付けた。

この日は通信関連銘柄が下落し、通信サービスセクターの重しとなった。宇宙開発企業スペースＸが全米で少なくとも８万カ所の携帯電話基地局の利用を確保するため、通信インフラ企業と協議していると報じられたことが材料となった。

ＡＴ＆ＴとＴモバイルはともに約８％下落し、ベライゾンは１．２％安。一方、スペースＸは１．９％上昇した。

アメリカン・エキスプレスは３．７％下落し、ダウ工業株３０種の重しとなった。同社は、２０２６年通期の利益予想を市場予想を上回る水準に引き上げた。また、事業再編の一環として世界の従業員の５％に当たる約３５００人を削減する計画を発表した。

来週は、アルファベット、マイクロソフト、アマゾン・ドット・コムのＡＩ「ハイパースケーラー」３社の四半期決算発表が予定されており、各社の設備投資見通しが市場の注目を集めそうだ。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．７２対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１５４億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億株。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞　金は３カ月ぶりの安値となり、週足では４カ月超ぶりの大幅な下落となる見通し。エネルギー価格の上昇によるインフレ懸念が強まり、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）の利上げ観測が強まったことが背景。金現物は東部夏時間午前１１時２０分（日本時間２４日午前０時２０分）時点で０．６％安の１オンス＝３９９８．３５ドルとなり、７月中旬以来初めて４０００ドルを下回った。米金先物１２月限の清算値は１．３％安の４００７．９０ドルだった。今週の下落率は４％に達し、６月以来最悪の週となる見通し。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞　３ドル超上昇し、約半年ぶりの高値で取引を終えた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビア攻撃を受け、中東からのエネルギー供給が一段と混乱するとの懸念が強まった。アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）当局も原油流出を報告した。    清算値は、北海ブレント先物が３．５５ドル（３．１４％）高の１バレル＝１１６．７２ドルと、４月２９日以来の高値。米ＷＴＩ先物は３．８０ドル（３．８％）高の１０３．２７ドルだった。    週間では北海ブレントが６％、ＷＴＩが２．３％上昇した。    ＵＡＥの気候変動・環境省は、ウンムアルカイワイン沖でタンカーからの原油流出が確認されたと発表した。流出の原因は明らかにしておらず、当局は該当するタンカーを特定していない。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: ヨルダン南部の教会で銃撃、7人死亡 当局「過激派テロ」との見方
item.description: [アル・ムシャイルフェ（ヨルダン） ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[アル・ムシャイルフェ（ヨルダン）　２３日　ロイター] - ヨルダン南部のカラク県にある教会で２３日、葬儀中に武装集団が発砲し、少なくとも７人が死亡、４０人が負傷した。ヨルダンの公安総局は、キリスト教徒少数派を狙った極めて異例の襲撃で、「過激派によるテロ行為」との見方を示している。武装グループは逃走中で、治安当局が行方を追っている。今のところ犯行声明を出した団体はない。

公安総局のアブドラ・マアイタ少将によると、銃撃事件が起きたのはカラク県のハムード教会。ファラヤ内相は、襲撃は「過激派」によるものとの見方を示した。ただ、ヨルダン国内外の組織との関係があるかについては、現段階で判断するのは尚早としている。

ヨルダンのアブドラ国王は事件発生から数時間後にカラク県を訪問。声明で「カラクでのテロ攻撃に最も厳しい報復で応じる。銃弾でヨルダン国民を分断できると思い込んでいる者に勝ち目はない。われわれは結束している」とし、犯行に及んだ者は「鉄拳で」処罰されるとした。

ハッサン首相は「テロリズムの思想と盲目的な過激主義の産物だ。われわれは社会がそのような道に進むことを許さない」とＸに投稿した。

国連のグテレス事務総長も今回の襲撃を非難。「民間人や礼拝施設を標的とした攻撃は容認できない」とＸに投稿した。

国営テレビ局アルマムラカが放映した映像で、３人の人物が歩道から教会に向けて発砲した後、樹木や低い塀の陰に身を隠し、その後、教会の入り口に向かって走る様子が確認できる。映像は教会の監視カメラで撮影されたものと見られ、ロイターは教会へ続く通路や周囲の塀などの特徴からこの映像の撮影場所を特定した。襲撃後に教会で撮影されたロイターの映像では、教会の入口付近の床に血痕が残されている様子が確認できる。

キリスト教徒はヨルダンで少数派。ただ、ヨルダンには聖書ゆかりの地が複数あり、世界各地からキリスト教の巡礼者が訪れている。米国のウォルツ国連大使はＸへの投稿で、今回の事件について「礼拝施設に対する卑劣で残忍な攻撃だ」と非難した。

item.title: トランプ氏、イラン対応後にキューバ問題対処 ルビオ氏派遣へ
item.description:
Bo Erickson Kanishka Singh
[フロリダ州フォートマイヤーズ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson　Kanishka Singh

[フロリダ州フォートマイヤーズ ２３日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２３日、フロリダ州の集会で、イランへの対応を終えた後にキューバ問題に対処し、合意をまとめるためルビオ国務長官を派遣すると述べた。

トランプ氏は９月、米国とキューバは合意に達するとの見通しを示し、軍事行動は必要ないと考えていると述べていた。

米国が実施した石油封鎖は、キューバに深刻な打撃を与えている。同国は燃料不足や停電に直面しており、インフラの機能不全が状況を悪化させている。

米国は６０年以上にわたってキューバへの禁輸措置を維持している。

item.title: 米国株式市場＝主要3指数軒並み下落、ハイテク株は持ち直し
item.description:
Lewis Krauskopf Tharuniyaa Lakshmi Ragini Mathur
[２３日 ロイター]...

item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝主要3指数軒並み下落、ハイテク株は持ち直し 5:24 配信

ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）の取引フロアで８月撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

マン・グループのチーフ・マーケット・ストラテジスト、クリスティナ・フーパー氏は「ＡＩ関連銘柄を疑問視する動きの余波は依然として残っている」と指摘。「来年、ＡＩデータセンター拡張への投資がこれまでの予想よりも少なくなる可能性は確かにある。だからこそ、市場に様子見姿勢が広がっているのだと思う」と述べた。

ニューヨーク証券取引所（ＮＹＳＥ）では値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．７２対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１５４億株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７２億株。

item.title: Marco Rubio calls on those seeking change in Cuba to partner with CIA
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio called on those seeking change in Cuba to partner with the CIA as President Donald Trump said Washington would "take care of Cuba" after dealing with Iran and send in the top US diplomat to finish the deal.
item.dc:creator: Bo Erickson, Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio called on those seeking change in Cuba to partner with the CIA as President Donald Trump said Washington would "take care of Cuba" after dealing with Iran and send in the top US diplomat to finish the deal. DETAILS AND QUOTES: "We'll take care of Cuba on our way back from Iran ... then we're going to send Marco Rubio in to finish up the deal," Trump told a rally in Florida. "To those who seek to create positive change in Cuba - now is the time," Rubio, who has been handling much of the Cuba-related policy for Trump, said on X on Friday. Rubio urged those disappointed by Cuba's government to "seize this opportunity to create the change you desire through a discrete partnership with the CIA," without elaborating further. The Trump administration [USN:L1N45L02I TEXT:"has previously stated"] its goal is to change Cuba's communist government. A US-imposed oil blockade implemented earlier this year has put Cuba under severe strain as it contends with fuel shortages and [USN:L1N44002K TEXT:"blackouts"] exacerbated by failing infrastructure. Washington has maintained an embargo on Cuba for over 60 years. The Trump administration has been [USN:L1N4590T5 TEXT:"stepping up pressure"] on Havana after the US military in January seized then-Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro in a deadly raid. Cuba's foreign minister told the UN General Assembly last month Cuba would always be open for dialogue with Washington. UN rights experts have condemned the oil blockade as a violation of international law while rights advocates say the Trump administration's threats have echoed an [USN:L4N3YE036 TEXT:"imperialist approach"]. Trump [USN:L1N45I044 TEXT:"predicted last month"] the US and Cuba would reach an agreement and that he did not think military action would be necessary.

item.title: 原油先物3ドル超上昇、半年ぶり高値 フーシ派攻撃で供給懸念
item.description:
Nicole Jao
［ニューヨーク ２３日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nicole Jao

［ニューヨーク　２３日　ロイター］ - 米国時間の原油先物は３ドル超上昇し、約半年ぶりの高値で取引を終えた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビア攻撃を受け、中東からのエネルギー供給が一段と混乱するとの懸念が強まった。アラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）当局も原油流出を報告した。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が３．５５ドル（３．１４％）高の１バレル＝１１６．７２ドルと、４月２９日以来の高値。米ＷＴＩ先物は３．８０ドル（３．８％）高の１０３．２７ドルだった。

週間では北海ブレントが６％、ＷＴＩが２．３％上昇した。

ＬＰＬファイナンシャルのチーフクロスアセットストラテジスト、アダム・ターンクイスト氏は「フーシ派が、エネルギーインフラを含むサウジ各地で一連の攻撃を実施し、供給混乱への懸念が相場を押し上げた」と述べた。

ＵＡＥの気候変動・環境省は、ウンムアルカイワイン沖でタンカーからの原油流出が確認されたと発表した。流出の原因は明らかにしておらず、当局は該当するタンカーを特定していない。

FAST

Oct 23 : OpenAI said on Friday it had resumed training of its most advanced AI models after tightening security and barring internet access, and disclosed a flaw in a widely used software that it found while testing its defenses. The disclosure comes amid concerns over the ability of increasingly capable AI agents to identify and exploit software flaws, including in the guardrails meant to contain them. OpenAI had paused training of its most capable models after one of its research models used a configuration error to gain limited internet access in September. The company said it contained the incident and used the pause to strengthen its defenses. To test them, OpenAI had teams of AI agents try to break out of their restricted environments. It said the agents found previously unknown flaws, which it had fixed, and training resumed on October 1.

During that exercise, the ChatGPT maker found a flaw in Brotli, a widely used data compression tool. The company said attackers could exploit the flaw by sending malicious data that lets them run their own code on affected systems, including those using popular web software such as Node.js, Bun and Envoy. OpenAI said the root cause was fixed in Brotli's source code in February, before it was known to create a security vulnerability, but no new version was released at the time. Brotli has since released updated versions and published a public record of the flaw after OpenAI disclosed it. Separately on Thursday, AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research said they found several new vulnerabilities in OpenAI's internal system, including an exploit agents could have used to keep hundreds of their actions from being monitored, in a pilot review earlier this year. OpenAI told the safety organizations it has since patched all vulnerabilities affecting its production safeguards, although METR and Redwood said they had not verified the fixes. OpenAI has been conducting a broad review of its AI models' activity since the Hugging Face incident in July, and has informed more than 100 organizations about incidents of unauthorized activity tied to its AI agents.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 仏、24日の抗議活動に警官７万人動員 先週末の暴動再発警戒
item.description:
Makini Brice Crispian Balmer
[パリ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Makini Brice　Crispian Balmer

[パリ　２３日　ロイター] - フランスで生活費の高騰などに抗議するデモが大規模な暴動に発展してから１週間が経過する中、ニュネス内相は２３日、暴力行為や略奪の再発を防ぐため、２４日に全国で予定されている抗議活動に対応するため７万人の警察官を動員すると発表した。政府が治安維持能力を失ったとの懸念を払拭するため、精鋭治安部隊や重武装の機動隊を通常の警察部隊とともに配備し、厳戒態勢で臨む。

ニュネス氏は記者団に対し「暴徒や略奪者、あらゆる暴力行為を行う者に対し一切妥協しない」と述べた。「極左」団体がインターネット上で公共施設を標的にし、一段の無秩序状態を引き起こすよう呼びかけていると言及し「これは平穏で友好的なデモではない。最大限の警戒態勢を敷き、断固として対応する。一切の違法行為を容認しない」と語った。

警察当局は２４日に首都パリで予定されるデモについて、労働組合による１件のみを許可。フランス最大の学生組合ＵＮＥＦや、２０１８年に発足した反体制運動「黄色いベスト運動」が申請した集会は許可されなかった。パリ以外の多くの都市でも抗議活動が禁止されたが、第２の都市マルセイユでは禁止命令が撤回され、労組によるデモの実施が認められた。

当局は特に、中部オルレアンで週末に開かれる極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」の年次党大会が新たな緊張の火種となる可能性を警戒。ニュネス氏によると、今週末に動員される警察官は前週末より１万人増員される。騎馬警官やヘリコプター、ドローン、対ドローン装備を全国に配備するほか、装甲車や放水車も待機。一部の要警戒地域で導入された夜間外出禁止令は継続されるという。

＜ルーブル美術館など休館、サッカー試合も延期＞

前週末の暴動再発への懸念から、パリの主要文化施設の一部は２４日、終日休館を決めた。対象にはルーブル美術館、オルセー美術館、オペラ座が含まれる。このほか、治安上の懸念から、サッカーフランス１部リーグのパリ・サンジェルマン（ＰＳＧ）対オリンピック・リヨン戦は開催日が２５日から２６日に変更された。一方、米ナショナル・フットボール・リーグ（ＮＦＬ）のピッツバーグ・スティーラーズ対ニューオーリンズ・セインツ戦は、トランプ米大統領が中止を求めたにもかかわらず、２５日にパリで予定通り開催されると見られている。

前週末の暴動で約３０００の店舗や事業所が略奪被害を受けていたため、経済団体も小売店に対し休業を呼びかけている。フランス商工会議所のアラン・ディ・クレセンゾ会頭は、一部の商店主は店舗を守るため野球バットや散弾銃などを準備しているとし、自警のために暴力に訴えないよう呼びかけた。

社会不安の拡大を受け、仏経済の先行き懸念が増大。政府が財政支出の抑制に十分取り組んでいないとの懸念が改めて意識される中、格付け会社ムーディーズが２３日にフランス国債格付けを引き下げるとの観測が市場で広がっている。

TORONTO: US President Donald Trump said on Friday (Oct 23) that Canada is working hard to make a trade deal with the United States. " Canada is working very hard to make a deal with us , and I hate to say this, but we have all the cards," Trump told reporters at the White Ho us e. A spokesperson for Dominic LeBlanc, Canada 's minister responsible for trade with the US , declined to comment. The US and Canada have been locked in a trade standoff since talks broke down in Aug us t, triggering new tariffs and retaliation on both sides of the border. The breakdown has widened a rift between the longtime allies, who have blamed each other for the failed talks. The dispute has spurred Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney to urge a further shift away from Canada 's biggest trading partner and cast doubt on the viability of the US -Mexico- Canada Agreement.

Meta Platforms, the

FAST

NEW YORK, Oct 23 : Big AI stocks were mixed on Friday, a day after the biggest decline in the Nasdaq Composite Index in four months, giving investors a welcome respite as they look forward to more information on Anthropic's forthcoming IPO and a further wave of earnings over the next week. Meta Platforms, the center of Thursday's storm, was fractionally lower following Thursday's 7 per cent decline. The operator of social media networks and major AI investor said in its earnings report this week that it would create a new class of shares in part to raise money for further capital spending, which was taken as evidence that the next leg of the AI buildout will be costly for shareholders. Other major AI players were mixed on Friday, with SpaceX, Oracle and Dell Technologies up 1 per cent to 2 per cent and Nvidia, Alphabet and Amazon down less than 1 per cent. Big semiconductor stocks were mostly higher after their largest decline since the summer on Thursday. Credit default swaps tracking the perceived risk of default at the biggest AI players were mostly modestly lower, with Meta's five-year CDS spread trading 0.3 per cent narrower at 123, according to LSEG data. The swaps enable investors to bet on a default using contracts typically with terms of five or 10 years, though contracts frequently change hands for the purposes of hedging positions and betting on near-term market moves.
